name: claudefuscator
description: Replaces configured incidental identifiers in tool output with stable tokens before they reach Anthropic, and restores them on screen locally.

secret_key.title: Claudefuscator key
secret_key.description: Shared secret used to derive tokens. Enter the SAME value in the Chrome extension options. Stored in your OS credential store, never written to settings.json, never sent anywhere.

config_path.title: Identifier list
config_path.description: Path to your claudefuscator.local.json (identifiers, internal domains, policy). Leave empty to search ./claudefuscator.local.json then ~/.claudefuscator/identifiers.json.
